T009 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (V n)),
  ScaleLaws ∧ CriticalLaws ∧ InvarianceLaws ∧ PowerLaws →
    ((0 ≤ dimH E ∧ dimH E ≤ ↑n) ∧
        dimH E ≠ ∞ ∧
          Bornology.IsBounded E ∧
            (∃ R, 1 ≤ R ∧ ∀ x ∈ E, ∀ (j : Fin n), |x.ofLp j| ≤ R) ∧
              (∀ (s δ : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 < δ → content s δ E < ∞) ∧
                (n = 0 → E = univ ∧ dimH E = 0) ∧
                  (Function.Bijective fun p => join p.1 p.2) ∧
                    (∀ (x : V n) (t : ℝ), base (join x t) = x ∧ height (join x t) = t) ∧
                      (∀ (z : V (n + 1)), join (base z) (height z) = z) ∧
                        ∀ (x y : V n) (t u : ℝ), dist (join x t) (join y u) ^ 2 = dist x y ^ 2 + dist t u ^ 2) →
      1 ≤ n →
        ∀ (q r ε : ℝ),
          dimH E < ENNReal.ofReal q → 0 < r → r ≤ 1 → 0 < ε → ∃ W, scaleCover r E W ∧ cost q W < ENNReal.ofReal (ε / 2)
'Translation.T009' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
